utterances.text: Hello, my name is Ed Rusky. I am also speaking on behalf of MP Free. The PAC is a civilian oversight body. Independence from law enforcement is the single most important aspect of meaningful and effective civilian oversight. Without that independence, there is no accountability and no foundation for community trust. We urge the City Council to release the PAC from its inappropriate dependence on the San Rafael Pacific Police Department by assigning a staff liaison to the PACK who is truly independent of law enforcement. The composition and training of the PACK leaves this body defenseless against the law enforcement interests that control its operations with a single exception. The PAC members have no prior knowledge or experience in police oversight or criminal justice and have never received the the training that they need to get. Ironically, the only member with relevant experience is a career prosecutor who ultimately served as a Marin County District Attorney, the county's chief law enforcement officer. This further entrenches the inappropriate law and enforcement dominion and control over the PAC. This isn't meant as an indictment of Ms. Kamena or of SRPD officers who manage the Pacific, but civilian oversight is premised on the fundamental truth. The law enforcement officers in the communities they serve perceive and experience policing very differently. Law enforcement oversight is no oversight at all. Only the City Council has the power to fix this. An independent staff liaison and training for the non professional members would be terrific but MD Free is here to help. Please reach out to us.
